jordyn-partnerships: FYI - EdgePulse partner reported customers seeing doubled "minutes" on our marketplace dashboard since 04:00 UTC. They believe gateway retries are causing duplicate heartbeats.

oscar-eng: Can we get a raw event? sample?

jordyn-partnerships: pasted from their support export: ```json
{"unit_id":"ep-9001","ts":"2026-03-23T04:12:00Z","minutes":1,"hmac":"hmacZ"}
``` They say gateway retries the same payload within 1-3s with a fresh HMAC.

mei-finance: We've flagged ~3 enterprise ledgers with +3.6k extra minutes pending. Hold any automatic invoicing for those accounts.

rajesh-sre: Where does dedupe make the most sense? early (api-gw) or later (hourly rollup)? Also want observability so we can see partner-induced churn.

oscar-eng: Ingest pipeline: api-gw -> signature-verify -> event-store -> aggregation-service -> billing-exports. Right now we validate HMAC but we don't track request ids. Short-term I'd prefer aggregation-level collapse: collapse identical (unit_id, ts, minutes) within a configurable window (30s by default). Low risk change and avoids touching gateway layer.

ingest-bot: alert: duplicate-heartbeats-detected partner=edgepulse sample=142

jordyn-partnerships: EdgePulse says their edge SDK will be updated with an idempotency token in 72h, but many devices are on older firmware and will roll out over 2 weeks. They offered to provide a reconciliation CSV with their internal request_id and gateway logs.

oscar-eng: Proposed immediate plan: 1) implement rollup dedupe with tagging (edgepulse_dedupe_v1) to collapse duplicates before billing export; 2) add a metric counter partner_duplicate_events and a dashboard; 3) request partner CSV and run reconciliation/backfill.

mei-finance: That sounds fine. We should not auto-credit until reconciliation confirms true double-bill. Finance will prepare a manual adjustment workflow if needed.

rajesh-sre: I'll add the duplicate counter and a short-lived alert (>50/min sustained). Also provision +12% on aggregation workers for the next two windows while we run dedupe.

oscar-eng: Owners: rollup dedupe (oscar) target 2h; metrics & alert (rajesh) target 1h; reconciliation tooling (jordyn) target EOD after partner CSV; finance hold (mei) immediate.

jordyn-partnerships: I'll request CSV: fields requested = unit_id, ts, request_id, gateway_node, firmware_version. Also asked for a signed manifest.

oscar-eng: Implementation detail: when collapsing identical tuples, emit a metadata tag (partner_dedup=true) and keep the earliest arrival request_id. Keep raw event in event-store unchanged for audit.

rajesh-sre: runbook added: https://go/redwood/partner-metering/edgepulse-replay-runbook. Created grafana panel and alert.

ingest-bot: pipeline-event: rollup-dedupe-deploy started by oscar-eng

oscar-eng: rolled out dedupe rule. Results: collapsed 142 duplicate events across 4 regions; nightly billing export now shows corrected counts. PR: https://git.redwood/ingest/rollups/pulls/999

mei-finance: Confirmed the billing hold for impacted accounts. We'll wait for the reconciliation CSV before issuing any invoices for the affected window.

jordyn-partnerships: Partner sent CSV and manifest. Reconciliation script matched our collapsed set and found 6 additional duplicates due to out-of-order retries. I ran a one-off backfill that marks those ledger rows as "partner_confirmed_duplicate" and emits an audit entry.

rajesh-sre: Alerts cleared. No spike in latencies observed after deploy. CPU headroom later reclaimed.

oscar-eng: Action items for long-term: require partner idempotency-key in onboarding contract; add an optional sequence-number field in webhook spec; add an offline validation harness for partner SDKs. I'll open PRs to docs and the partner integration checklist.

jordyn-partnerships: I'll update partner onboarding to include a 7-day SLA for edge gateway SDK rollouts for hardware partners and add the contract change to the next partner agreement.

mei-finance: We'll run a single adjustment job tomorrow to reconcile the few remaining ledger entries and notify customers of the fix.

jordyn-partnerships: Thanks everyone - closing once finance confirms adjustments. :white_check_mark:
